author: theboxplymouth
title: Artist Commission: Tides & Tales Project
content: OPPORTUNITY CALLOUT: ARTIST COMMISSION 🌊🎙️📦 @take_a_part_uk are looking for an artist-producer (or collective) to lead 'Tides & Tales', a multidisciplinary arts and heritage project for the East End community of Plymouth. Total Commission: £16,000. Delivery: November 2026 – March 2027. EOI Deadline: Friday 23 October 2026. Send CV, 2-page outline proposal, and work samples to kim@takeapart.org.uk by 23 October.
